quick_notes.title: Non-Conventional Energy
quick_notes.detail: Solar: Rajasthan/Gujarat (India has massive targets). Wind : Tamil Nadu (Muappandal) is the leader in India. Nuclear : Kalpakkam (TN), Tarapur (MH).

quick_notes.title: Mineral Hubs
quick_notes.detail: Chotanagpur Plateau: "Ruhr of India" due to immense mineral wealth. Mumbai High : Largest offshore oil field.

topic_title: TNPSC Geography: Mineral & Power Resources of India
lesson_intro: Today we study the 'Fuel of Development'. India has rich deposits of minerals, especially in the Chotanagpur plateau (the Ruhr of India). We explore metallic minerals like Iron and Gold, and non-metallic minerals like Mica and Limestone. We also look at the energy sector—Coal, Petroleum, and the rising Solar power. For TNPSC, knowing the major mining hubs like Kudremukh (Iron) and Digboi (Oil) is essential. Let's power up your knowledge today.
